dl.title: Download MP3
dl.subtitle: Paste a YouTube, TikTok or Spotify link. Cover art, artist and album are embedded in the file. Saved to your Downloads folder by default.
dl.empty: Nothing here yet. Paste a link above to get started.
st.converting: Converting to MP3 and embedding cover art…
pv.multi: {n} links will be added to the queue.
pv.spotify: Spotify doesn't allow direct downloads: the app finds the matching audio on YouTube and adds Spotify's info and cover art.
toast.pasteEmpty: The clipboard is empty or doesn't contain text.
toast.needFfmpeg: ffmpeg is required to convert to MP3: Settings → Tools.
ban.auto: The app can download and install it for you. An internet connection is required.
ban.manual: The app can fetch yt-dlp for you. Install ffmpeg with `brew install ffmpeg` (macOS) or `sudo apt install ffmpeg` (Linux).
ban.denoDesc: It helps yt-dlp solve YouTube links and avoid “HTTP Error 403: Forbidden”.
set.title: Settings
set.subtitle: Personalize the look, downloads and window behavior.
set.modeDesc: Follow the system or pick one.
set.colorDesc: The whole interface follows the color you pick (Material Design palette).
set.qualityDesc: “Best” takes the highest audio stream and converts it to top-quality VBR MP3 (V0).
set.crop: Crop cover art to a square
set.cropDesc: 16:9 video thumbnails are center-cropped to fit music players.
win.rememberDesc: Reopens at the size you last resized it to.
win.maximizedDesc: Starts with the window maximized every time.
set.toolsDesc: yt-dlp downloads the audio; ffmpeg converts it to MP3 and embeds cover art.
tool.denoHint: Not installed · helps yt-dlp avoid HTTP 403 errors on YouTube
tool.denoHintOther: Not installed (optional) · macOS: brew install deno
set.footnote: Only download content you have the right to use. Spotify doesn't allow direct downloads, so the app reads the track info from Spotify and finds matching audio on YouTube.
about.desc: Download MP3 from YouTube, TikTok and Spotify with cover art and tags.
about.author: Author
e.no_tauri: Run the app with Tauri (npm run dev).
e.ytdlp_run: Couldn't run yt-dlp ({d}). Install yt-dlp in Settings → Tools.
e.ytdlp_io: Couldn't read the output of yt-dlp.
e.ffmpeg_manual: Install ffmpeg with a package manager: macOS `brew install ffmpeg`, Linux `sudo apt install ffmpeg`.
e.deno_manual: Install Deno: macOS `brew install deno`, Linux `curl -fsSL https://deno.land/install.sh | sh`.
e.spotify_bad_link: Invalid Spotify link. Paste a track link like open.spotify.com/track/…
e.spotify_only_track: Only Spotify track links are supported (open.spotify.com/track/…), not albums or playlists.
e.spotify_read: Couldn't read the track info from Spotify ({d}). Check your connection and try again.
e.url_invalid: Enter a link that starts with http or https.
e.ffmpeg_missing: ffmpeg is missing. Install it in Settings → Tools.
e.yt_signin: YouTube asks you to sign in or verify. Update yt-dlp in Settings, then try again.
e.http_403: The server refused the download (HTTP 403). The app already tried several methods. Update yt-dlp and install Deno in Settings → Tools, then try again.
e.no_format: YouTube returned no audio format. Update yt-dlp in Settings, then try again.
e.mp3_failed: The audio was downloaded but couldn't be converted to MP3. Check ffmpeg in Settings.
e.spotify_no_match: No matching audio was found on YouTube for this track.
e.ytdlp_no_output: yt-dlp produced no MP3 file. Update yt-dlp in Settings, then try again.
e.m_tagging: Writing track info and cover art…
